skills.description: Plan multi-step work with dependencies, bounded scope, and observable acceptance criteria.
Research technical or product questions with traceable sources and explicit uncertainty.
Implement a feature or refactor within an existing codebase while preserving unrelated work.
Diagnose reproducible failures and verify a targeted fix using evidence.
Review a concrete patch for actionable correctness, security, and regression defects.
Design and run behavior-focused tests for changed contracts and meaningful failure modes.
Implement or audit visible UI against an established design system and actual rendered behavior.
Design or review API contracts for compatibility, validation, errors, and reliable retries.
Write or update technical documentation grounded in actual behavior and verified examples.
Validate and publish an explicitly authorized release with traceable artifacts and verification.
